{{Quote|Pirate activity is still high enough that we need combat capable pilots on active duty locating and eliminating them. You have free reign to use lethal force against any Commerce Raiders you locate around Tatooine. The Empire will pay a bounty on every one you destroy. Good luck.|[[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Akal Colzet|Colzet]], to a pilot|<ref name="SWG:JtL" />}}
The '''Commerce Raiders''', also known as the '''Bestine Pirates''', were a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] group active in the [[Tatoo system/Legends|Tatoo system]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:JtL" /> They named the area of space they controlled, the [[Pirate's Gold]], after their favorite [[Spice/Legends|spice]]: the [[Muon Gold]].<ref name="SWG:PMG" /> In space battles, the Commerce Raiders flew [[Z-95-AF4 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95-AF4 Headhunters]] and [[Rihkxyrk assault fighter]]s.<ref name="SWG:JtL" />

==History==
{{Quote|We want to crush the pirates and demonstrate that Imperial resolve remains strong. I want you to get into space and destroy any Commerce Raiders you find. Your mission is to eliminate four of the pirates.|Lieutenant Colzet, to a pilot|<ref name="SWG:JtL" />}}
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Akal Colzet]] dispatched [[Storm Squadron/Legends|Storm Squadron]] to hunt down Commerce Raider starfighters in the Tatoo system.<ref name="SWG:JtL" />
